The Network Administrator II serves as a senior technical resource and team lead responsible for the administration, maintenance, monitoring, and security of enterprise LAN, WAN, VoIP, wireless, and encryption network services. The position provides advanced troubleshooting support, oversees network operations and service delivery, and advises military and civilian customers on enterprise information technology solutions.

The Network Administrator II supports network development initiatives, coordinates maintenance activities, and ensures the availability, reliability, and security of network infrastructure. This position applies advanced knowledge of routing, switching, network management, and cybersecurity principles to diagnose and resolve complex network issues while maintaining compliance with applicable security requirements.

Reporting to the NOC Chief Watch Officer, the Network Administrator II provides technical guidance and mentorship to junior Network Administrators, coordinates operational activities across supported sites, and serves as a primary escalation point for network outages, incidents, and anomalies. The position is responsible for ensuring timely reporting, coordination, and resolution of network events while collaborating with internal and external stakeholders to maintain mission-essential communications services. Program: OMDAC-SWACA.
This position offers company-paid housing and transportation, a completion bonus and tuition reimbursement program!
